# OrgComputers

OrgComputers is a shared workspace for your AI agents. Your team and every agent it uses share one place for projects, context and tools: repos and workstreams each with their own context, plus sessions, docs, code, notes and links, and the APIs, integrations and databases agents can call. Nothing is copied between tools, and nothing stays on one laptop.

From Cursor, Claude Code or Codex, an agent pulls what the team already decided before changing code, and every answer cites where it came from. The workspace links your stack through one MCP server (GitHub, Linear, Slack, Notion, Jira, Confluence, PagerDuty, Google Drive and internal systems) and merges entities across systems, so one service known by five names in four tools becomes a single record with its PRs, tickets, incidents and decisions attached.

Setup is one command per agent: sign in with Google, generate an API key from the dashboard (Connect, admin only), then install the Handoff plugin. Every answer points back to its source. OrgComputers does not replace GitHub, Linear or Slack, it links them.

Honest caveats: this is a young third-party SaaS and no pricing page is published as of 2026-10-04, so the cost of running a team workspace is unknown. You are handing your team's code context, docs and integrations to a third-party service, so review their security posture before connecting production systems.
